{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: only completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter: exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
valid_df = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Verify that no QA orders remain
assert len(valid_df[valid_df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]) == 0, "QA orders not filtered out"

# Check channel distribution in valid data
df_valid_channel = valid_df[['channel', 'customer_segment']].value_counts().to_frame('count')
df_valid_channel = df_valid_channel.reset_index()
print('Valid (completed, non-QA) channel and customer segment distribution:')
print(df_valid_channel)

# Compute average revenue per order by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = valid_df.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print('Average revenue per completed order by channel:')
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)"}
